caption: The drawing shows a round, lidded ceramic serving dish with two handles and a detailed depiction of its lid from a top-down perspective. The dish is primarily off-white or cream in color. On the body and lid of the dish, there are painted floral designs with red and green leaves and petals. The two handles and the knob at the top center of the lid are decorated with blue accents. The top view of the lid highlights the blue center knob and the symmetrical arrangement of the green and red floral patterns on the cream-colored background. The composition places the perspective view of the complete dish with its lid at the upper center of the image, while the lid alone, shown from above, is positioned below the dish on a plain light beige background.
title: Bowl with Lid
